primitives.name: Tactical Alignment Response

primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A_r': 'dimensionless unit for alignment response to right tackle play', 'P_o': 'dimensionless unit for offensive play type'}
primitives.assumptions: Alignment response is deterministic given P_o and prior defensive configuration.
